import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load dataset
data = {
    "StichtagDat": ["2024-12-31", "2025-12-31", "2019-12-31", "2020-12-31", "2021-12-31"],
    "AlterV10Lang": ["30- bis 39-Jährige"] * 5,
    "KreisLang": ["Kreis 7", "Kreis 7", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10", "Kreis 10"],
    "HundefarbeText": ["beige", "beige", "beige/schwarz", "beige/schwarz", "beige/schwarz"],
    "AnzHunde": [1, 1, 1, 1, 1]
}

df = pd.DataFrame(data)

# Set plot style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create the bar plot
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.countplot(data=df, x='KreisLang', hue='HundefarbeText', palette='Set2', dodge=True)

# Set the title and labels
plt.title('Number of Dogs by District and Color', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('District', fontsize=14)
plt.ylabel('Number of Dogs', fontsize=14)
plt.legend(title='Dog Color')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png')
plt.close()
